build: L2, the bed across its season. A click on a soil bed on the desktop Map opens the bed in the default sidebar or the optional floating card. Clicking a painted crop also opens that planting's row. Both views show the season strip, planting rows with their 40-pixel photographs, dates and status on the planning date, and openings with their first three fits. One row opens for its date and variety, with a link to the whole planting and a way back to the same row. Grown for sale uses the shared definitions and existing impact message and Undo. Edit layout shows the season's worth before and after shortening a bed where the change is allowed. The floating card reveals a bed it covers without changing zoom. No new data is stored.

changes.did: Click a bed on the Map to see the whole season, with planting photos, quick edits and openings.
steps: Click a painted crop. Its row opens inside the bed's season, with date, variety and All of this planting. The bed name takes you back to that row.
